implementation_summary: Describe the bounded change actually performed; do not claim planned work as completed.
changes: Identify each exact code/configuration/documentation change and its immutable revision.
test_results: Identify the exact test command, environment, result and retained output evidence.
deviations: List each deviation from the approved plan; use an explicit statement when none occurred.
rollback_reference: Identify the reviewed rollback procedure and its evidence reference.
